lastCompletedStory.title: Flip the planner + auditor spawns through the container + add plan-runner preflight seam (fail-closed)

nextStoryContext: US-006 (B-2 CAM-152) is complete. plan-runner.ts now: (1) accepts workerIsolation ('host'|'container'), preflightContainerFn, and escalateFn in RunPlanPhaseOptions; (2) runs runContainerPlanPreflight before each planner and auditor spawn; (3) is fail-closed in container mode: if preflightContainerFn returns ready:false, calls escalateFn (fire-and-forget) and returns { kind: 'container-preflight-failed', phase: 'planner'|'auditor', reason } without dispatching un-wrapped workers; (4) wraps shellCmd via dockerExecWrap when workerIsolation==='container' for both planner and auditor. Steps 4-7 extracted to runPlanWorkerSequence helper to satisfy biome noExcessiveLinesPerFunction(max=80) and noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity(max=15). sidecar.ts: added PlanContainerOpts interface + buildPlanContainerOpts helper, wired into makeProductionPlanPhaseFn. New test file: 19 tests across 7 describe blocks (AC1-AC7). All quality gates pass. All 6 user stories on this PRD now have passes:true; the PRD is ready for review.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Same docker exec -it cam-worker pattern validated in US-005 applies to planner and auditor dispatch in plan-runner.ts. dockerExecWrap prefixes the shell command identically. No API changes detected since US-005 validation.
